facts.title: What Zurich wants to know, and what it costs you

items.title: You have to declare it
items.body: Anyone who files a tax return in Zurich declares income and assets worldwide. That includes a flat in Valencia, Berlin or Kyiv, even if nobody lives there.

items.title: Switzerland does not tax it
items.body: Swiss law taxes real estate only in the country where it stands, and Switzerland's tax treaties say the same. Zurich removes the flat from your taxable wealth and income.

items.title: It only moves your tax rate
items.body: The value and a notional rent are used to set your rate. For a typical flat the effect is small. Leaving the flat out is what gets expensive: back taxes, interest and a fine.

items.title: Describe your flat
items.body: Country, city, size, what you paid or what it is worth, and how it is used today: kept for yourself, lived in by family, rented out, or not usable.

items.title: Get the Zurich values
items.body: Tax value at 70% of the price. Notional rent at 4.25% for flats or 3.5% for houses. The 20% flat deduction for maintenance. All converted to francs.

items.title: Copy the numbers into your tax return
items.body: The result mirrors the Zurich property form line by line, with a ready German note for the remarks field. Type it into ZHprivateTax or the paper form.

cta.title: Ten minutes now saves a letter from the tax office later
cta.body: Have the purchase price and the size of the flat ready. That is all you need.

next: Open your tax return in ZHprivateTax or on paper and go to the Liegenschaftenverzeichnis.
Add each property with its country and copy the numbers field by field.
Choose the flat deduction (Pauschalabzug) for maintenance.
Paste the German note into the remarks and keep your documents at home.
assumptions: Tax value: 70% of the purchase price or estimated market value, in francs.
Notional rent: 4.25% of the tax value for flats, 3.5% for houses. None if the property cannot be used.
Rented property: the rent actually received instead of the notional rent, converted with the average rate for the year.
Maintenance: flat deduction of 20% of the notional rent or rent received.
Amounts are rounded to whole francs and multiplied by your ownership share.
Standard cases only: no mortgage on the property, and no purchase, sale or inheritance during the year. Those need an adviser.

sources.title: Where the rules come from
items: All property, also abroad, is declared in the Liegenschaftenverzeichnis. Notional rent of 4.25% and 3.5%, the 20% flat deduction, and lines 6 and 31.1 of the tax return.
Property abroad is not taxed in Switzerland and counts only for the rate.
Official year-end and annual average exchange rates.
Tax value at 70% of the purchase price. This is practice reported by Zurich fiduciaries, not an official directive.

guide.title: Filling in the Zurich form, step by step
guide.lead: The canton's online tax return is called ZHprivateTax. The paper form has the same fields. Here is where your flat goes.

steps.title: Open the Liegenschaftenverzeichnis
steps.body: This is the list of real estate. Since tax year 2024 all properties are declared only here, including those in other cantons and abroad.

steps.title: Add the flat
steps.body: Enter city and street in Latin letters. Under Kanton / Land choose the country. As type choose Stockwerkeigentum for a flat or Einfamilienhaus for a house, and enter the area in m².

steps.title: Enter the income
steps.body: In the field Eigenmietwert / Mietzinseinnahmen enter the notional rent from your dix.tax sheet, or the rent you received if the flat is rented out.

steps.title: Choose the flat deduction
steps.body: For Unterhalts- und Verwaltungskosten choose Pauschalabzug. It is 20% and needs no receipts. Actual costs are only worth it if they were higher, and then you need a detailed list.

steps.title: Enter the tax value
steps.body: In the field Verkehrswert enter the tax value from your sheet. The program carries the totals to line 6 (net income from property) and line 31.1 (property) of the main form.

steps.title: Add the German note
steps.body: Paste the note from your sheet into the remarks (Bemerkungen). It explains how you valued the flat and asks the tax office to allocate it abroad. The office does the allocation itself.

steps.title: Submit and keep your documents
steps.body: The deadline in Zurich is 31 March. You can extend it online, free of charge, until 30 November. You do not need to send documents about the flat, but keep them in case the office asks.

docs: Purchase contract, or the inheritance or gift document
Land register extract from the country where the property stands
Rental contract and proof of rent received, if rented
Photos, damage reports or official confirmations, if the property cannot be used
The exchange rate you used and where it came from

glossary.liegenschaftenverzeichnis: List of real estate. The form where every property is declared.
glossary.eigenmietwert: Notional rent. Income you are deemed to have from a home you keep for your own use.
glossary.steuerwert: Tax value. The value of the property for wealth tax, in Zurich also called Verkehrswert on the form.
glossary.pauschalabzug: Flat deduction. A fixed percentage you may deduct without receipts.
glossary.satzbestimmend: Counts for the rate only. The item is not taxed itself but raises the rate on everything else.
glossary.steuerausscheidung: Tax allocation. The tax office separates what is taxable in Zurich from what belongs to another country.
glossary.quellensteuer: Tax at source. Tax that the employer deducts directly from the salary.
glossary.schutzstatus: Protection status S. The residence status for people who fled the war in Ukraine.
glossary.gemeindesteueramt: Municipal tax office. Your first contact for forms, deadlines and questions.
glossary.fristerstreckung: Deadline extension. More time to file, requested online.
glossary.bemerkungen: Remarks. Free text field for explanations to the tax office.
glossary.selbstanzeige: Voluntary disclosure. Reporting earlier omissions yourself, once in a lifetime without a fine.
